race.comment: TICKELOVA (2) sets the standard after a sharp first-up second at Newcastle, where she led, looked the winner and spaced the rest despite being an outside chance in betting. The 1100m is still to be answered after one previous unplaced attempt around the trip, but she comes back from provincial company and has the strongest recent race performance. UMBUSI (7) is the immediate danger off a sound debut fourth at this track, with the wide run throughout giving that effort more merit than the margin alone. SHASORT (12) finished behind UMBUSI in the same race but closed from well back at long odds, suggesting natural improvement can bring her into the contest. MIDNIGHT REVOLT (8) debuts for Gai Waterhouse & Adrian Bott, has had two Randwick trials and is a half sister to Listed winner Whispered Secret, so it would not surprise if that stable polish brings her forward on race day.
